subject: numeracy
nipun_lo: Grade 2 goal: reads and writes numbers up to 999; this episode covers tens and ones up to 99
chapter: NCERT Class 2 Mathematics: tens and ones
notes: Group objects into bundles of ten. A two-digit number is some tens and some ones: 34 is 3 tens and 4 ones. Read and say numbers from their tens and ones, and the reverse. Ten ones make one ten. Compare two-digit numbers by looking at the tens first.
